artifact.name: qpdf relocatable Linux x86_64 binary archive

runtime.name: qpdf-json
runtime.value: version 2, generalized stream decoding, inline stream bytes

runtime.name: platform
runtime.value: Linux x86_64, relocatable Ubuntu LTS binary archive

annotations.inventory: subtype, rectangle, quadrilaterals, border, flags, action kind, and URI
annotations.policy: URI actions and complete Next/AA/OpenAction graphs reported; non-http, non-https, non-mailto, and active actions fail

fonts.embedding: FontFile, FontFile2, or FontFile3 stream digest
fonts.inventory: page resource name, object, subtype, base font, encoding, descendant subtype
fonts.mappings: complete ToUnicode stream byte length and digest plus ordered ActualText marker operands

graphics.clips_masks: clip operators, ExtGState soft masks, image soft masks
graphics.page: MediaBox, CropBox, other boxes, Rotate, UserUnit
graphics.transparency: stroke/fill alpha, blend mode, alpha-is-shape, soft mask

images.classification: unmanifested resources are undeclared and fail exact expected count
images.fields: object, dimensions, color space, bit depth, filters, mask, soft-mask stream bytes and digests, interpolation, occurrence count
images.inventory: all page and recursive Form Image XObject resources whether painted or unused

metadata.document: encryption, signatures, IDs, revisions, linearization, Info, XMP, attachments
metadata.notices_manifest: reported through XMP and attachment carriers when present
metadata.output_intent: intent identity plus complete ICC bytes, digest, v2.1 header, spaces, and tag signatures

operations.report: ordered operator, operands, and sequence inventory
operations.tokenizer: owned deterministic PDF content tokenizer with recursive Form XObject traversal and cycle/depth failures
operations.vectors: paths, rectangles, paint, clip, and no-paint operators

parser.json: qpdf JSON v2 with inline generalized-decoded streams
parser.recovery: enabled only to capture deterministic warnings; every warning still fails

state.process: fresh qpdf and Python process per inspection
state.serialization: sorted-key compact JSON plus one LF
state.sharing: no parser or document state shared between fixtures or repeats

warnings.exit_2: error status and no structural success
warnings.exit_3: warning status and exact normalized messages
warnings.policy: any warning or error is a hard structural failure
